title: Борисъ Годуновъ
basis: Pushkin's play, as distinct from Mussorgsky's opera (RG's art-form rule). It is never performed whole in this corpus, only as scenes: the 1899 Pushkin centenary galas (Александринскій "2 сцены", Малый "Корчма на Литовской границѣ изъ траг."), "Сцена у фонтана, изъ драмы" (Маріинскій 1904), Михайловскій 1908 [сц.]. Genre as printed for the Корчма scene. AREA FOR EXTERNAL RESEARCH: confirm from contemporary press that the 1899 gala scenes were spoken, not sung.

title: Каменный гость
basis: Pushkin's little tragedy, as distinct from Dargomyzhsky's opera. Only scenes, at the 1899 Pushkin centenary galas (Александринскій and Малый, drama theatres; companion items printed "др. сц."). AREA FOR EXTERNAL RESEARCH: confirm the gala scenes were spoken.

title: Русалка
basis: Pushkin's unfinished play, as distinct from Dargomyzhsky's opera. Only the 1st scene, at the Малый Pushkin memorial gala, 26-28 April and 6 May 1899, on a bill of Pushkin's dramatic scenes. The 1891/1893 Михайловскій "драмы Русалка" excerpts stay unlinked (RG, 2026-09-26). AREA FOR EXTERNAL RESEARCH: confirm the gala scene was spoken.
